articles.title: Europe Bakes in Its Fifth Heatwave of the Year as Ocean Temperatures Hit New Records
articles.summary: Western Europe is suffering through its hottest two-month stretch ever recorded, as a fifth powerful heatwave sweeps across the continent this summer. Scientists warn that temperatures in countries like Spain, France, and the United Kingdom have broken long-standing records. At the same time, the surface temperature of the world's oceans has reached an all-time high, alarming climate researchers. Experts say these extreme weather events are becoming more frequent and severe because of climate change caused by human activity. Governments are being urged to take faster action to cut carbon emissions and protect people from dangerous heat.

lv1: How many heatwaves has Europe experienced this year? (今年歐洲共經歷了多少次熱浪？)
What part of the Earth's surface has also broken temperature records? (地球上哪個部分的溫度也創下了新紀錄？)
lv2: Why do scientists think heatwaves are happening more often and becoming more extreme? (科學家為什麼認為熱浪愈來愈頻繁和嚴重？)
How might record-high ocean temperatures affect sea creatures and coastal communities? (海洋表面溫度創新高，會怎樣影響海洋生物和沿海社區？)
lv3: Some people argue that individuals should change their daily habits to fight climate change, while others say only governments and big companies can make a real difference. Which view do you agree with more, and why? (有人認為個人應改變日常習慣以對抗氣候變化，也有人認為只有政府和大企業才能帶來真正改變。你較認同哪個觀點？為什麼？)

If your city experienced a severe heatwave, what measures should schools, hospitals, and the government take to protect vulnerable people such as the elderly and young children? (如果你的城市遭遇嚴重熱浪，學校、醫院和政府應採取哪些措施，保護長者及幼童等脆弱群體？)

articles.title: Salmonella Food Poisoning Outbreak Spreads Across 27 US States, Linked to Mexican Peppers
articles.summary: A serious outbreak of Salmonella food poisoning has now spread to 27 states across the United States, with more than 300 people falling ill and over 30 needing hospital treatment. Health officials believe the source of the outbreak is jalapeño peppers grown on a farm in Mexico, which were then supplied to two well-known Mexican restaurant chains. People became sick after eating at these restaurants between June and July. The US Food and Drug Administration is investigating the farm and has urged consumers to check where their food comes from. This outbreak highlights the importance of food safety and careful food handling.

lv1: Which food was identified as the likely cause of the Salmonella outbreak? (哪種食物被認為是沙門氏菌爆發的可能原因？)
How many people became ill during this food poisoning outbreak? (今次食物中毒爆發中，有多少人染病？)
lv2: Why is it important for food suppliers and restaurants to carefully check where their ingredients come from? (為什麼食品供應商和餐廳需要仔細核查食材的來源？)
What steps can governments and health authorities take to prevent food poisoning outbreaks from happening in the future? (政府和衛生機構可採取哪些措施，預防日後再次發生食物中毒爆發？)
lv3: When food is imported from another country and causes illness, who should be held responsible — the exporting country, the importing country, the restaurant, or the farm? Explain your reasoning. (當進口食物導致疾病爆發，應由哪方負責——出口國、進口國、餐廳還是農場？請解釋你的理由。)

Some people argue that importing food from other countries is risky and we should only eat locally grown food. Do you agree? What are the benefits and drawbacks of eating local versus imported food? (有人認為進口外國食物存在風險，我們應只食用本地種植的食品。你同意嗎？本地食品與進口食品各有什麼好處和壞處？)

articles.title: 歐洲今夏第五波熱浪來襲　全球海洋溫度創歷史新高
articles.summary: 今年夏天，西歐正經歷有記錄以來最炎熱的兩個月。目前第五波熱浪正席捲歐洲多國，西班牙、法國及英國等地氣溫屢創新高。與此同時，全球海洋表面溫度亦打破紀錄，令科學家深感憂慮。專家指出，極端天氣事件日趨頻繁，與人類活動引致的氣候變化密切相關。各國政府被敦促加快削減碳排放，並採取措施保護市民免受酷熱威脅。

lv1: 今年夏天歐洲共發生了多少次熱浪？
除了陸地，還有哪個地方的溫度也創下了紀錄？
lv2: 科學家認為極端天氣事件為何愈來愈頻繁？
全球海洋溫度上升，會對海洋生態和漁業帶來什麼影響？
lv3: 面對氣候變化帶來的極端天氣，你認為個人、企業和政府各自應承擔哪些責任？誰的責任最大？
如果香港未來夏天的熱浪變得更頻繁，你認為學校應如何調整上課安排，以保障學生的安全和健康？

articles.sourceUrl: https://www.stheadline.com/hongkong-news/3612345/星島獨家-紅磡寰宇殯儀館大停電-疑有靈堂遺體受高溫影響
articles.title: 紅磡殯儀館酷熱天氣下發生大停電　冷氣系統失效引發關注
articles.summary: 本港近日持續酷熱，紅磡寰宇殯儀館於八月九日發生嚴重電力故障，導致館內冷氣及抽氣系統全面癱瘓。多個樓層煙霧瀰漫，部分靈堂只能依靠蠟燭照明。有傳遺體因室溫過高而受到影響，部分喪家被迫緊急將先人遷往其他殯儀館。負責營運的東華三院向家屬致歉，並表示正全力搶修，館方暫只提供有限度服務。業界人士指出，殯儀館設施老化問題早已存在，促請當局認真正視及盡快安排大規模維修。

lv1: 寰宇殯儀館發生了什麼事故？
負責管理殯儀館的機構是哪一個？
lv2: 殯儀館停電對喪家和遺體造成了什麼影響？為什麼冷氣系統對殯儀館如此重要？
有業界人士指出設施老化問題存在已久。你認為機構應如何定期檢查和維護舊有設施？
lv3: 對於公共服務機構（如殯儀館、醫院）的設施老化問題，你認為政府、營辦機構和公眾各自應負上什麼責任？
酷熱天氣對香港各類設施和市民帶來不同威脅。你認為香港在應對極端天氣方面，目前最需要改善的是哪個範疇？為什麼？
